By analyzing the connectivity and pattern of black cells in each tile, we can find an arrangement for tiles (A), (C), (D), and (E). However, for tile (B), the black cells are located at positions (1,1), (1,3), (2,2), (3,1), and (3,3).

An analysis of the possible cuts in tile (B) shows that any cut resulting in a 3-cell piece must isolate the corner at (1,1). However, this results in the black cell at (2,2) being adjacent to only the single corner cell. The required L-shaped tromino has a black cell that connects to two black cells. Therefore, the black cells in tile (B) cannot be partitioned into the required shapes.

Answer: B
